title: Vallee's Invisible College research group of the 1970s
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Vallee's Invisible College research group of the 1970s, about 1970s at United States (no place named), and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: in the 70s Jacques named both his independent group of UFO researchers and his seminal book about their learnings the invisible College

You have Jacqu Fleet, you know, uh calling his working group on UFO ufology, studying UFOs with Jon Heinik and a bunch of these guys in the 70s the invisible college. He even named his book The Invisible College, which is uh homage to, you know, Robert Bole.
